verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭ : ਵੇਸ਼ਵਾ ਦੇ ਰੂਪ ਵਿਚ ਮਨਮੁਖ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 17 : veshavaa dhe roop vich manmukh

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਹੁ ਮਿਤੀ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲਖਣ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: jiau bahu mitee vesuaa sabh kulakhan paap kamaavai|

en.bdb: A prostitute having many lovers commits every species of sin.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਹੁ ਦੇਸਹੁ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਤਿਹੁ ਪਖਾਂ ਨੋ ਅਉਲੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: lokahu dhesahu baaharee tih pakhaa(n) no aaula(n)g laavai|

en.bdb: An outcast  from her people and her country, she brings disgrace on all the three sides, i.e. her father's mother's and the family of her father-in-law.

verses.gurmukhi: ਡੁਬੀ ਡੋਬੈ ਹੋਰਨਾ ਮਹੁਰਾ ਮਿਠਾ ਹੋਇ ਪਚਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: ddubee ddobai horanaa mahuraa miThaa hoi pachaavai|

en.bdb: Ruined herself, she ruins others and still goes on gulping and digesting poison.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘੰਡਾ ਹੇੜਾ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਦੀਪਕ ਹੋਇ ਪਤੰਗ ਜਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gha(n)ddaa heRaa mirag jiau dheepak hoi pata(n)g jalaavai|

en.bdb: She is like the musical pipe which lures the deer, or lamp which burns the moth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੀ ਸਰਾਈ ਜਰਦ ਰੂ ਪਥਰ ਬੇੜੀ ਪੂਰ ਡੁਬਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhuhee saraiee jaradh roo pathar beRee poor ddubaavai|

en.bdb: Due to the sinful activities her face in both the worlds remains pale because she behaves like a boat of stone which drowns its passengers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਨੁ ਅਠ ਖੰਡ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਸਟਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: manmukh man aTh kha(n)dd hoi dhusaTaa sa(n)gat bharam bhulaavai|

en.bdb: Similar is the mind of apostate (manmukh), scattered and led astray by superstitions in the company of evil doers.
And similar to courtesan's son bearing no name of his father, the apostate is also not owned by anyone.
